statement: Existing temporal relevance methods like TempRALM are designed for specific retriever types (e.g., dense Contriever-based) with score normalization tailored to those retrievers, while our idea proposes a retrieval-agnostic component that can be applied to both dense and sparse retrievers without modification to their core algorithms.

evidence.quote: based on a general-purpose dense retriever that uses a dual- encoder architecture, based on the Contriever [7]
